items.text: Man ebitimbre, tek ibiwinjo dwand Yehova Mungu peri cu, man ibiketho cwinyi kum timo lembang’ola pare ceke m’ang’olo iri tin, nia Yehova Mungu peri bidodi malu wi thek ceke m’i ng’om:
e mugisa maeni ceke bikwenyi, man gibirubi, tek ibiwinjo dwand Yehova Mungu peri.
Mugisa bikwenyi i adhura, man mugisa bikwenyi i podho.
Mugisa bikwanyu kodhi m’i ii, ku nying’ mi ng’om peri, ku kodhi mi lim peri, ku nyai mi dhiang’ peri, ku nyithindh udul rombe peri.
Mugisa bikwanyu katoko peri kud ajiku kwen peri.
Mugisa bikwenyi kinde m’imondo, man mugisa bikwenyi kinde m’iwok woko.
Yehova bigoyo judegini i weng’i m’uai i wii: gibiwok i wii ku yo acel, man gibiringo i weng’i i yo abiro.
Yehova bing’olo mugisa i wii i dero peri, man i gin ceke m’iketho cingi i kume: man ebimio mugisa iri i ng’om ma Yehova Mungu peri mio iri.
Yehova biketho inyang’ ni thek ma leng’ ire gire, calu ekwong’o iri; tek ibigwoko lembang’ola pa Yehova Mungu peri, man ibiwotho i yo pare.
E kodhidhanu ceke m’i ng’om bineno nia ilwongri ku nying Yehova; e lworo binegogi i kumi.
E Yehova bimedoi mi bero, kum kodhi m’i ii, man kum kodhi mi lim peri, man kum kodhi mi ng’om peri, i ng’om ma Yehova kwong’o ni kwaru nia ebimio iri.
Yehova biyabu dhu piny m’akana pare ma polo iri, kara emi koth mi ng’om peri i nindone, man kara emi mugisa wi tic ceke m’i cingi: man ibimio banja ni thek dupa, e ibigamu banja ngo.
Man Yehova bikethi ni wie, ni yib re ngo; e ibibedo ru malu kwa, e ibibedo nweng’ ungo; tek ibiwinjo lembang’ola pa Yehova Mungu peri, m’ang’olo iri tin, kara iketh cwinyi i kumgi m’itim kogi,
man ilokri cen ungo kum lembe moko m’ang’olo iri tin, yo ku cing’ ma yor acwic, kadi ma yor acam, ya ilub tok mungu mange kara itim igi.
Ento ebitimbre, tek ibiwinjo dwand Yehova Mungu peri ngo, miketh ko cwinyi kum timo lembang’ola pare ceke ku cik pare m’ang’olo iri tin, nia kwong’ maeni ceke biwok i wii, man gibirubi.
Ibibedo akwong’a i adhura, man ibibedo akwong’a i podho.
Katoko peri bibedo akwong’a kud ajiku kwen peri.
Kodhi m’i ii bibedo akwong’a, ku nying’ ng’om peri, ku nyai mi lim peri, man nyithindh udul rombe peri.
Ibibedo akwong’a kinde m’imondo, man ibibedo akwong’a kinde m’iwok woko.
Yehova bioro kwong’ i wii, kud ang’abacwiny, man juk, i gin ceke m’iketho cingi i kume ya itim, cil m’inyothri ko, man cil m’irwinyo ko pio; kum dubo mi giratima peri, m’iweka kudo.
Yehova biketho thong’om umok i kumi, cil m’enyothi ko kud i ng’om, ka m’imondo i ie nimwonye.
Yehova bigoi ku thokor, man ku thonam, ku kwodokum, man ku cekkum, ku palamularu, man ku motho, ku laimo de; e gibiriemi cil m’inyothri ko.
E polo peri ma ni i wii malu bibedo lelele, man ng’om ma ni i theri bibedo nyunyu.
Yehova biketho koth mi ng’om peri ubed ni kwio kud utur: ebiai i polo ebiloro i wii, cil m’inyothri ko.
Yehova biketho jugoi i wang’ judegi peri; ibiwok i yo acel i wigi, man ibiringo i yo abiro i wang’gi: man jubikethi kun ku kun i kind thek ceke mi ng’om.
E avuji bibedo cemo ni winyo ceke ma kor polo, man ni yedi ceke m’i ng’om; e ng’atu moko mbe ma biriemogi.
Yehova bigoi ku vur ni Misiri, ku pong’ic, man ku nyac, kud agara de, ma kei ungo.
Yehova bigoi kud abelu, man ku loiwang’, man ku wang’uic mir adunde;
e ibiwotho kr kr ku dieceng’, calu abinga wotho kr kr i mudho, e mierolembe bikwenyi ngo i yo peri: e jubinuri ru anura man jubiyeki ru ayaka, e ng’atu moko m’ubodhi bibedo umbe.
Ibinyomo dhaku, e ng’atu mange bivuto kude: ibigomo ot, man ibibedo i ie ngo: ibipidho podho mir ulok, e ibicamu nyinge ngo.
Koni dhiang’ peri jubinego i weng’i, e ibicamu kume moko ngo: jubiyaku kana peri i weng’i, e jubidwoke i beng’i ngo: jubimio rombe peri ni judegini, e ng’atu moko bibedo umbe iri m’ubodhi.
Woti ku nyigi bimire ni dhanu mange; e weng’i bineno tel, man ebivoc ni avagi m’unegi ceng’ du; man tego moko mbe ma bibedo i cingi.
Nying’ ng’om peri, ku tic mi muli peri ceke, thek m’ing’eyo ngo bicamu; e jubinuri ru anura man jubidii thiri thiri;
ketho nia abelu bimeki kum gin ma weng’i bineno.
Yehova bigoi i cong, man i tielo, ku vur ma rac, ma keire iri ngo, ugambre i tiendi cil i wii.
Yehova biteri, kud ubimo peri m’iketho i wii, ba thek ma fodi ing’eyo ngo, in kadi kwaru; e ibitimo ni mungu mange kuca, ma gi yen ku kidi.
E ibidoko ni wang’uic, man koi, ku cac, i kind kodhidhanu ceke ka ma Yehova biteri i ie cen.
Ibitero kodhi dit i podho, man ibicoko nyanok; kum bonyo bicame.
Ibipidho podho mir ulok man ibilwero kumgi, ento kadok amadha de ibimadhu pigulokne ngo, kadi ibicoko nyingulokne de ngo; kum ukoko bicamugi.
Ibibedo ku yendulam i kind kieu peri ceke, ento ibiwiri ngo ku moje; kum ulam peri bioyo nyinge.
Ibinyolo nyithindho ma co ku nyithindho ma nyir, ento gibibedo peri ngo; kum gibicidho i ng’eca.
Yedhi peri ceke ku nying’ ng’om peri gibibedo ni bonyo.
Umondo ma ni i kindi biidho i wii malu malu; man ibidok piny piny.
Ebimio banja iri, e ibimio banja ire ngo: ebibedo ni wie, man ibibedo ni yib.
E kwong’ maeni ceke biwok i wii, man gibiriemi, e gibirubi, cil m’inyothri ko; kum iwinjo dwand Yehova Mungu peri ngo, kara igwok lembang’ola pare man cik pare m’eng’olo iri;
e gibibedo i wii ni giranyutha man ni wang’uic, man wi kodhini mi nja.
Kum itimo ni Yehova Mungu peri ngo ku mutoro, man ku berocwiny, ni kum sagri mi gin ceke;
ka kumeno ibitimo ni judegini ma Yehova bioro i wii, ku kec, man ku rieu, man ku muneru, man ku canpiny mi gin ceke: e ebiketho mberembere mi nyunyu i ng’uti, cil m’enyothi ko.
Yehova bikelo thek i kumi ku bor, kud i tung’ ng’om, calu acur m’uberingo; thek m’ibiwinjo dhoggi ngo;
thek ma wang’e tek, ma biparu pi wang’ judongo ngo, kadi binyutho bero de ngo ni awobi,

m’ebicamu nying’ lim peri, ku nying’ ng’om peri, cil m’inyothri ko; ma biweko iri cam bende ngo, kadi pigulok ma nyasa, kadi mo, kadi nyai mi lim peri, kadi nyithindh udul rombe peri, cil ma ginyothi ko.

E gibitieki kud ali i dhugang’ peri ceke, cil ma gang’ peri ma tek ma wiu de birwombre ko, m’igeno gen ni kume, i ng’om peri ceke mba mba; e gibitieki kud ali i dhugang’ peri ceke i ng’om peri ceke mba mba, ma Yehova Mungu peri mio iri.
E ibicamu nying’ ring’kumi giri, ring’kum woti ku nyigi, ma Yehova Mungu peri mio iri, i atiek man i lem ma tek ma judegini biridi ko.
Ng’atu ma lebe lebe i kindwu, ma ng’ic hai, wang’e bibedo col yo bang’ umin mire, man yo ba dhaku mi kore, man yo ba dong’ nyithindho pare m’ebedo ko m’udong’;
ketho nia ebimio kum ring’ nyithindhe ngo m’ebicamu ni kindgi moko, kum ebedo ku gin moko ngo m’udong’ ire, i atiek man i lem ma tek ma jade gini biridi ko i dhugang’ peri ceke.
Ywa 4:10
Dhaku ma lebe lebe ma ng’ic ma ni i kindwu, m’uyenyo ngo eponj nyono ng’om kum ng’icne ma lebe lebene, wang’e bibedo col yo ba nico pare mi kore, man yo ba wode, man yo ba nyare,
man yo ba nyathi pare m’uai i kind tiende, man yo ba nyithindhe m’ebinyolo; kum ebicamugi ling’ ling’ ni kum can mi gin ceke, i atiek man i lem ma tek ma judegini biridi ko i dhugang’ peri.
Tek ibiketho cwinyi kum timo lembe ceke mi cik maeni ma jukiewo i kitabu maeni ngo, kara ilwor nying’ maeni mi yung man mi ndiri, en e YEHOVA MUNGU PERI;
Yehova bilund ketho masendi peri bed ni wang’uic, man masendi mi kodhini, en e masendi ma dit, man mi bedo hai, ku tho ma rac, man mi bedo hai.
E ebikelo tho ceke mi Misiri i wii kendo, m’ilworo; e gibimoko i kumi.
Tho kubang’e kubang’e bende, ku masendi kubang’e kubang’e, m’ugore i kitabu mi cik maeni ngo, de Yehova bikelo i wii, cil m’ibinyothri ko.
E welwu bidong’ nok, ento nwang’u wubedo calu cero m’i polo ni udul; kum iwinjo dwand Yehova Mungu peri ngo.

Man ebitimbre, nia, calu anyong’a nego Yehova i kumwu kara etimwu ber, man emedwu, e anyong’a binego Yehova i kumwu kumeca m’erwiny kowu, man m’enyoth kowu de; e jubiyakuwu kud i ng’om m’imondo i ie nimwonye.
E Yehova bikethi i kind kodhidhanu ceke, ugambre i kajik mi ng’om acel cil kum kajik mi ng’om mucelo; e ibitimo ni mungu mange kuca, ma fodi k’ing’eyo ngo, in kadi kwaru, en e mi yen man kidi.
Man i kind thek maeni ibinwang’u bedoyo ngo, man yom bibedo umbe ni die tiendi: ento Yehova bimio iri adunde ma miel kuca, ku corowang’, ku ng’eyong’ec mi ywak;
e kwo peri bibedo ji ji i weng’i; man lworo binegi dieceng’ ku diewor, e genogen mi kwo peri bibedo mbe.
Kugweno ibiwacu kumae, Mundo ande ebed uthieno ba! man uthieno ibiwacu kumae, Mundo ande ebed kugweno ba! ni kum lworo mir adundeni ma binegi, man ni kum nen mi weng’i m’ibineno.
E Yehova bidwoki i Misiri kendo ku combo, i yo m’awacu iri pire kumae, Ibinene kendo ngo: e wubing’ieuru giwu ni judegiwu kuca ni ng’eca man ni bong’, e ng’atu moko mbe ma bing’iewowu.
